note: Private campground at the County Road D bridge over the Red Cedar River, beside the Red Cedar State Trail, a mile south of Menomonie; the camping area sits back from the river behind woods and the trail. Canoe, kayak and tube rentals with a shuttle. Some sites are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator site, its RezStream engine (site list; 2027 not on sale yet), RV Life camper reports, Google and imagery read. No posted rate: 2026 camper reports $40 (W/E back-in) and $55-60 (FHU pull-through). 26 of ~45 sites sold online (~58% nightly). Booking -> operator/RezStream, season May 1-mid Oct, hookups 50/W/S, max rig 65 (allstays) -> 50 (engine), facilities and the $5 extra-person fee written. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PRICE (private): no rate posted on the operator site and the RezStream engine has nothing on sale for 2027 yet (June and August 2027 searches return 'unable to find anything available'). 2026 camper reports (RV Life, operator has a web page so they cannot price the entry): $40 for a water/electric back-in (site 23), $55-60 for a full-hookup pull-through (sites 19, 31, 1). The ordinary site is the W/E back-in (16 of the 21 RV sites sold online) at about $40 - price gate likely passes; the five FHU pull-throughs are over $50. Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km. RV Life tier $$ (avg $38). Presence passes (working site + phone; Google 4.3/136).

LONG-STAY: RezStream sells 26 sites online (21 RV + 5 tent) against the stored 45 total, so roughly 19 are seasonal (~58% nightly). Camper wording: 'Several permanent campers', 'a fair amount of permanent sites' (2026), 'mainly seasonal campers with just a few sites for travelers' (2021 Tripadvisor). Passes the five tests on what was read (online nightly booking, 2+ nightly); no wording discouraging nightly guests. Note says some sites are seasonal.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept, but the stored evidence names the wrong river - the campground is on the Red Cedar River (not the Chippewa). Imagery: the river lies about 150 m west of the camping loops behind the Red Cedar State Trail and woods. Suggested evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-16: loops at 44.8366,-91.9511 sit ~150 m east of the Red Cedar River behind the state trail and continuous woods; no site on the bank'.

WEBSITE: https://www.masirvingtoncampground.com/ works; suggest adding the engine on a second line: https://guest.rezstream.com/search/mas-irvington-campground-and-rentals-llc. (Google's menomoniecamping.com serves the same site.) PHONE 715-235-2267 confirmed.
